nodes.title: Text
nodes.description: A piece of text you type.

nodes.title: Number
nodes.description: A number.

nodes.title: Toggle
nodes.description: On or off.

nodes.title: Select
nodes.description: Pick one option from a list.

nodes.title: Seed
nodes.description: A seed. Leave random on for a new seed every run.

nodes.title: Image
nodes.description: Upload an image or pick one from the Library.

nodes.title: Audio
nodes.description: Upload a clip or pick one from the Library.

nodes.title: Video
nodes.description: Upload a video clip.

nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: Upload a PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown, HTML or text file for Load Document.

nodes.title: Flow Input
nodes.description: A value supplied when the flow runs: from the Run dialog, an MCP agent or the player.

nodes.title: List
nodes.description: A list of text items, one per line.

nodes.title: LLM Generate
nodes.description: Ask a language model. Use {{name}} in the prompt to insert inputs. Add a JSON schema to get structured output.

nodes.title: Agent
nodes.description: A local language model that can search a knowledge base or (optionally) the web before it answers. It never runs code or edits files. With an image connected it answers with the Vision model.

params.label: Vision model (when an image is connected)

params.default: You are a helpful assistant. Cite sources when you used a tool.
params.label: Instructions

nodes.title: Classify
nodes.description: Pick the category that fits the text best, with a confidence.

nodes.title: Extract Fields
nodes.description: Pull structured fields out of text, shaped by a JSON schema.

nodes.title: Chat Input
nodes.description: The message the person typed in the chat player, and the conversation so far. Run from the editor, it uses the test message.

nodes.title: Chat Memory
nodes.description: Keep only the last turns of the conversation, as a list or as a transcript for a prompt.

nodes.title: Chat Output
nodes.description: Entrypoint the chat player calls for each message: its reply is shown in the chat.

nodes.title: Describe Image
nodes.description: Ask a vision model about an image.

params.default: Describe this image in one paragraph.
params.label: Question

nodes.title: Template
nodes.description: Fill {{name}} placeholders from the inputs.

nodes.title: JSON Get
nodes.description: Read a field from JSON with a path like `characters.0.name`.

nodes.title: JSON Build
nodes.description: Build a JSON object from inputs.

nodes.title: Split to List
nodes.description: Split text into a list by lines or a separator, or into overlapping chunks for retrieval and long documents.

nodes.title: Join List
nodes.description: Join a list into text.

nodes.title: Rank by Meaning
nodes.description: Rank texts against a query with the embedding model.

nodes.title: Random Pick
nodes.description: Pick items from a list at random (seeded).

nodes.title: Random Number
nodes.description: A seeded random number in a range.

nodes.title: Dice
nodes.description: Roll dice like 2d6+1.

nodes.title: If
nodes.description: Route a value to `then` or `else` by a condition. The other branch is skipped.

nodes.title: Switch
nodes.description: Route a value to one of several outputs by matching text.

nodes.title: Compare
nodes.description: Evaluate an expression over inputs a and b.

nodes.title: For Each
nodes.description: Run the nodes inside this node's group once per list item. Inside, use the `item`/`index` outputs; connect a node inside the group to `collect` to gather results.

nodes.title: Loop
nodes.description: Repeat the steps in this node's group for a few rounds: generate, train, score. A dashed feeds-the-next-round wire carries the score step's failures into the next round's recipe seed. Round 1's held-out rows split once into probe rows (their failures feed back) and test rows (never fed back; their score decides when to stop).

params.label: Feed failures into the next round

nodes.title: First Available
nodes.description: Pass on the first input that has a value (joins If branches).

nodes.title: Make List
nodes.description: Collect inputs into one list.

nodes.title: Combinations
nodes.description: Every combination of named lists, one object per combination ({x: 1, y: "a"}, ...): settings grids, XY plots and sweeps. Feed `items` to a For Each.

nodes.title: Run Flow
nodes.description: Run another of your saved flows as one step. `values` fills its inputs by Flow Input name or block label; `outputs` holds its Flow Outputs by name. Nests at most 3 flows deep.

nodes.title: Edit Fields
nodes.description: Set or add fields on an object (or on every object in a list) from expressions. Expressions see the object as `item`, plus `index` and the flow's parameters.

nodes.title: Map List
nodes.description: Turn every item into a new value with an expression (`item`, `index`).

nodes.title: Filter List
nodes.description: Keep the items an expression is true for (`item`, `index`); the rest go to `dropped`.

nodes.title: Sort List
nodes.description: Sort a list by an expression (`item`); numbers before text, empty values last.

nodes.title: Remove Duplicates
nodes.description: Drop items whose key (an expression over `item`) was already seen; the first one wins.

nodes.title: Merge Data
nodes.description: Combine two inputs: append lists, merge objects (b wins), or join two lists of objects on a key field.

nodes.title: Generate Image
nodes.description: Text to image, or image to image when an image is connected.

nodes.title: Edit Image
nodes.description: Edit an image with an instruction (edit-capable image models).

nodes.title: Remove Background
nodes.description: Cut out the subject (SAM segmentation) to a transparent PNG.

nodes.title: Find Mask
nodes.description: Mask a subject described in words (SAM 3), for inpainting or a face fix.

nodes.title: Extend Canvas
nodes.description: Add space around an image and a mask over it, for outpainting with Generate Image.

nodes.title: Upscale
nodes.description: Upscale an image.

nodes.title: Crop / Resize
nodes.description: Resize, crop or fit an image.

nodes.title: Adjust Image
nodes.description: Crop, change brightness, contrast or saturation, blur, invert, flip or rotate an image.

nodes.title: Composite Images
nodes.description: Place one image on another: position and size are fractions of the base image.

nodes.title: Text on Image
nodes.description: Write text on an image, such as a title or a meme caption.

nodes.title: Compose Grid
nodes.description: Lay images out as a grid or comic page, with optional captions.

nodes.title: Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: Pack frames into a sprite sheet.

nodes.title: Generate Video
nodes.description: Text or image to video. One video renders at a time.

nodes.title: Video Frame
nodes.description: Take a frame from a video (first, last or at a time).

nodes.title: Edit Video
nodes.description: Trim a clip, change its speed, and keep its sound or lay a new audio track under it (a speed change drops the clip's own sound).

nodes.title: Join Videos
nodes.description: Join clips into one MP4, in order, at the first clip's size and frame rate (audio is dropped).

nodes.title: Playlist
nodes.description: Play several videos in order.

nodes.title: Speak
nodes.description: Text to speech with a built-in or saved voice, or a voice cloned from a reference clip (some voice models also need what is said in it).

nodes.title: Music / SFX
nodes.description: Generate music or a sound effect.

nodes.title: Transcribe
nodes.description: Speech to text.

nodes.title: Join Audio
nodes.description: Join clips in order with an optional gap.

nodes.title: Load Document
nodes.description: Read the text out of a PDF, Word (.docx), Markdown, HTML or text file.

nodes.title: Add to Knowledge Base
nodes.description: Add a document to one of your knowledge bases (the same ones chat searches), creating it if needed. Parsed and embedded locally with Studio's embedding model; waits until the document is indexed.

nodes.title: Search Knowledge Base
nodes.description: Find the passages in a knowledge base that best match a question (keyword and meaning search). Connect `after` to an Add to Knowledge Base block to search once its document is indexed.

nodes.title: Hugging Face Dataset
nodes.description: A dataset from the Hub or one you downloaded.

nodes.title: Run a saved recipe
nodes.description: Run a Data Recipe saved on the Data Recipes page and output its dataset. To edit a recipe here, bring it into Flows as a Data Recipe group.

nodes.title: Recipe Dataset
nodes.description: Runs the Data Recipe group it sits in as one job and outputs the dataset; select it to edit the recipe's models, seed and processors. Added on its own, it starts a new recipe group.

nodes.title: Recipe column
nodes.description: One column of a Data Recipe group. Double-click to edit it with the Recipe Studio editor; wires show which columns its prompt reads.

nodes.title: Rows to Dataset
nodes.description: Turn a JSON list of rows into a training dataset.

nodes.title: Fine-tune
nodes.description: LoRA fine-tune a model on a dataset, optionally holding out rows to score later. Waits for training to finish.

params.label: Hold out % (scored later, never trained on)

nodes.title: Export Model
nodes.description: Export a checkpoint to GGUF, merged weights or a LoRA adapter.

nodes.title: Chat With Checkpoint
nodes.description: Load a checkpoint and ask it a prompt.

nodes.title: Join Tables
nodes.description: Stack tables into one (columns are merged by id).

nodes.title: Summarise Table
nodes.description: Group rows and summarise number columns (mean, median, stddev, ...).

nodes.title: Compare Tables
nodes.description: Delta and ratio of a metric against a baseline table (matched on key columns) or a baseline row.

nodes.title: Chart
nodes.description: Plot table columns as a bar or line chart.

nodes.title: Preview
nodes.description: Show any value: text, JSON, image, audio, video or a list.

nodes.title: Save to Library
nodes.description: Save media into a Library folder.

nodes.title: Flow Output
nodes.description: Name a result: returned by MCP `run_flow` and shown in the run summary.

nodes.title: Story Generator
nodes.description: Write a whole branching story from a premise with an LLM (structured output). Re-run with a new seed for a new story.

params.label: Tag lines with expressions (e.g. happy, sad)

nodes.title: Illustrate Story
nodes.description: Generate a background for every scene and a portrait for every character (prepared mode).

nodes.title: Character Expressions
nodes.description: Make the same character with other expressions from a base portrait, cut out like the base. Connect to a Character's expressions.

nodes.title: Sound Effect
nodes.description: A named sound for `[sound name]` in Scene dialogue. Connect an uploaded clip or a generated one.

nodes.title: Narrate Story
nodes.description: Pre-render every line with text to speech, one voice per character.

nodes.title: Story
nodes.description: The story's root: title, variables and art style. Connect it to the first Scene.

nodes.title: Character
nodes.description: A character: name, look, voice and portrait.

nodes.title: Scene
nodes.description: A scene: background, who is on stage and dialogue lines (`Name: text` or `Name (happy): text`, one per line; `[show Name happy at left with dissolve]`, `[hide Name]`, `[sound door]`, `[pause 1.5]` direct the stage).

params.default: Narrator: It was a quiet morning.
params.label: Dialogue
Write dialogue with the LLM when entered

nodes.title: Choice
nodes.description: A menu of choices; each choice handle leads to a Scene.

nodes.title: Jump If
nodes.description: Go to `then` when the condition holds, otherwise `else`.

nodes.title: Random Event
nodes.description: Go to one of the outgoing scenes at random (weights optional).

nodes.title: Set Variable
nodes.description: Change variables, then continue.

nodes.title: Ending
nodes.description: An ending.

nodes.title: Story Player
nodes.description: Compile the authored Story/Scene/Choice graph (or a generated story) and open it in the player.

nodes.title: Next Scene (live)
nodes.description: Entrypoint the player calls in live/infinite mode: writes the next scene as JSON from the story state.

nodes.title: Scene Art (live)
nodes.description: Entrypoint the player calls to paint a scene background or a portrait on demand.

nodes.title: World Generator
nodes.description: Design a small world from a premise with an LLM: NPCs with personas, items, a quest and regions.

nodes.title: World Art
nodes.description: Generate sprites for the player, NPCs and items, and tile textures, then cut them out.

nodes.title: World
nodes.description: Author a world by hand (JSON) or edit a generated one.

nodes.title: NPC
nodes.description: A character the player can talk to.

nodes.title: NPC Reply (live)
nodes.description: Entrypoint the world player calls when you talk to an NPC: replies in character from the world state. Long conversations are summarised in the background, so each NPC remembers what was said, and new quests keep appearing as old ones are finished.

params.default: Stay in character. Keep replies under 60 words.
params.label: Rules

nodes.title: Schedule
nodes.description: Runs the flow every few minutes or on a cron schedule, only while Unsloth Studio is open (missed times are not made up). Owner account only, after you approve it. Run by hand it fires once now.

nodes.title: Webhook
nodes.description: Runs the flow when its secret URL gets a POST with a JSON body, only while Unsloth Studio is open. Owner account only, after you approve it. Run by hand it passes the test payload.

nodes.title: HTTP Request
nodes.description: Calls a public web address (no local or private hosts). Owner-run flows only, and only hosts you approved.

nodes.title: Python
nodes.description: Runs your Python in Studio's sandbox. `inputs` holds the connected value; set `result` to what the block outputs (anything JSON). Owner-run flows only, and only code you approved.

nodes.title: NPC Plan (live)
nodes.description: Entrypoint the world player calls once per NPC per game day in a simulated world: plans the day as blocks of time at the world's places, from the NPC's persona, routine and memories. After Park et al. 2023.

nodes.title: NPC Chat (live)
nodes.description: Entrypoint the world player calls when two NPCs meet in a simulated world: writes their short chat and what each learns from the other, so news spreads through the village. After Park et al. 2023.

nodes.title: Describe a Place
nodes.description: Lays out a place from a short description: the model lists areas, props and how they relate (near, against a wall, facing, in an area) and a solver puts them on free tiles the player can still walk to. The 3D scene editor calls it; a refused answer is asked again twice, then a built-in layout is used.

params.default: A small market square with a well
params.label: Description

nodes.title: World Player
nodes.description: Open the world in the player. View picks the top-down map or the first-person 3D walk (Auto uses what the world asks for, else the map).

nodes.title: Remember
nodes.description: Add observations to a memory stream. Rates how important each one is with the language model (or a fixed score) and embeds them for retrieval. After Park et al. 2023, Generative Agents.

nodes.title: Recall
nodes.description: Find the memories that matter for a query: recency, importance and relevance, each normalised, weighted and summed. Falls back to keyword overlap without an embedding model.

nodes.title: Reflect
nodes.description: Once enough has happened (importance since the last reflection reaches the threshold), ask three questions about recent memories and add the insights they lead to, citing their evidence.

nodes.title: Agent Summary
nodes.description: A short description of an agent from its memories: core traits, current occupation and how things are going. Feeds prompts that need to know who the agent is.

nodes.title: Plan the Day
nodes.description: A day plan in a few broad strokes (start, minutes, activity, place), with places limited to a list you give. One model call per day.
